subject: Dedicated GPU capacity — readout planning & calendar conflict resolution
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Harris <laura.harris@edgescale.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated GPU capacity — readout planning & calendar conflict resolution

Hi Laura / team,

Thanks again for the productive call last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused architecture readout covering: pool sizing, autoscaling behavior under burst traffic, and strong isolation patterns (multi-tenant vs dedicated pools). Proposed length is 75 minutes + 15 minutes for deployment/next-steps Q&A.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Apr 13, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Apr 14, 09:00–10:15 (we can shorten to 60m)
- Thu Apr 15, 15:00–16:30

Attached is a draft agenda and a short runbook excerpt for the isolation section. Can you confirm which slot works for your tech and procurement leads? If none of these are good, please suggest alternatives and we’ll deconflict on our side.

Agenda highlights:
- 15m: customer workload profile + SLOs
- 25m: pool topology + autoscale policy tradeoffs
- 15m: isolation & tenancy controls (networking/KMS/tenant bleed scenarios)
- 20m: operational runbook and failover playbook

CCing Marissa (solutions) and Karthik (runtime) — they will lead the walkthrough. Mina, can you bring the current capacity projection for the recommended pool sizes?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: agenda_dedicated_capacity_v1.pdf)

From: Laura Harris <laura.harris@edgescale.ai>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU capacity — readout planning & calendar conflict resolution

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear agenda. The topics look good; we especially want to validate isolation guarantees and data residency controls for one of our regulated workloads.

Conflicts on Apr 13–15 for our infra lead (unexpected travel). Can we push to Mon Apr 19 11:00–12:30 PDT or Tue Apr 20 08:00–09:30 PDT? Procurement (procurement@edgescale.ai) asked to be present for any discussion that touches pricing/commits — I’ve CC’d them here.

Also: please include a short section on network segmentation diagrams — our security architect will expect it. If you can attach the runbook excerpt and any brief network notes, that would help speed the internal approvals.

Thanks,
Laura Harris
Head of Platform Partnerships, EdgeScale Analytics
(Laid out availability; requested runbook + network notes)

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example

Attachments I’m adding here: dedicated_pool_runbook_v3.docx (excerpt with playbook), network_topology_notes.png (segmentation sketch). Marissa/Karthik — flagged for the network sketch at 11:20 in the agenda. Mina — we'll need the pool-sizing projection table before Friday so Laura's procurement can do a quick cost check.

Updated agenda (short):
- 10m: intros + objectives (Aditya)
- 20m: workload profile & SLOs (EdgeScale)
- 25m: pool topology & autoscale patterns (Karthik)
- 15m: isolation & network segmentation (Marissa)

If procurement wants a separate 30-minute pricing walkthrough after the readout, we can schedule that for Tues Apr 20 09:00 PDT.

Cheers,
Aditya

Looks good — confirmed from our side for Mon Apr 19 11:00–12:30 PDT. A couple quick notes I’ll cover during the session so Laura’s security architect has the answers ready:

- We’ll show two autoscale profiles (latency-prioritized and cost-prioritized) and the steady-state token-throughput assumptions that drive the sizing table.
- For isolation, expect a short demo of tenant-network policies and an explanation of how KV-cache isolation is enforced across pools.
- I attached a quick pointer slide to the shared Drive with kernel/quantization tradeoffs (will upload by EOD).

Mina — please confirm the sizing table upload by Friday EOD so we don’t block procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Infra Architect, Redwood Inference
